'''Dour Mountain''' was a mountain peak that was located at the southeastern edge of the [[Whiterock Wastes]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], overlooking the [[Clabburn Tundra]]. The [[Crescent Canyon Mine]] was built into the southern face of the mountain, and the [[Crescent Crossing]] bridge was located just east of the mountain.
